COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte as rumours only.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

   D. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   B. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.

   A. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   B. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   D. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property
